Clean — only the intended files changed. Here's a summary:

## Summary

- **`backend/app/models.py`** — added `is_verified: bool = False` to `UserBase`, which flows through to the `User` table model and `UserPublic` schema automatically.
- **`backend/app/api/routes/users.py`** — added `POST /{user_id}/verify`, superuser-only (via `get_current_active_superuser` dependency), returns `UserPublic`, 404s if the user doesn't exist.
- **`backend/app/alembic/versions/e5bedb5bf684_add_is_verified_to_user.py`** — new migration adding the `is_verified` column (chained after `fe56fa70289e`, the current head), with a server default of `false`.
- **`backend/tests/api/routes/test_users.py`** — added `test_verify_user_super_user`, `test_verify_user_not_found`, `test_verify_user_without_privileges`, following the file's existing patterns (including the `db.refresh()` idiom used by `test_update_user` to avoid stale identity-map reads).

Verified end-to-end: spun up a local Postgres, ran `alembic upgrade head` (migration applies cleanly), ran the full `test_users.py` suite (30/30 pass), and ran `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh` (mypy, ty, ruff check, ruff format — all clean). `git status` confirms only the 3 intended files were modified plus the 1 new migration file.
